relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: The pERK-IR cells were fewer in the ION-CCI + CGRP Ab group than in the ION-CCI, ION-CCI + vehi, ION-CCI + CGRP, and ION-CCI + ctrl IgG groups (p < 0.001 each, Fig 3C).

relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant decrease was found in the ION-CCI + CGRP Ab group as compared to the ION-CCI (p < 0.05), ION-CCI + vehi (p < 0.05), ION-CCI + CGRP (p < 0.01), and ION-CCI + ctrl IgG (p < 0.01, Fig 5B) groups.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: in the present study, the CGRP administration into the TG decreased the head-withdrawal threshold in naïve rats

key_findings: Anti-CGRP antibody into the trigeminal ganglion restored head-withdrawal threshold and reduced pERK, CGRP and D2 receptor immunoreactivity after ION ligation.
CGRP into the TG lowered threshold in naive rats but did not further worsen ION-ligated rats.
